campbell.title: Campbell City Council — September 15, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council considered updates to the city's theater use policy, a cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose for resurfacing work, and the city's annual investment policy update for fiscal year 2026-27. The Council also considered a budget adjustment to fund a replacement project.
keyTopics: Proposed modifications to Council Policy Section 14 (Theater Use Policy), effective September 16
Cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose, not to exceed $335,000, for resurfacing work
Annual update to the city's investment policy for fiscal year 2026-27
Budget adjustment to fund replacement of remaining equipment or infrastructure

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — September 16, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council took up routine business along with several land-use matters, including final map approvals for two property subdivisions and two appeals of Planning Commission decisions on residential projects. The Council also discussed options for law enforcement services ahead of upcoming town hall meetings where residents can weigh in.
keyTopics: Two appeals of Planning Commission decisions: a design review/setback variance for a home and ADU at 14650 6th Street, and a three-lot subdivision with tentative map and design review approval at 14486 Oak Place
Final map approvals for lot splits at 20517 Carniel Avenue and 19351 Saratoga Los Gatos Road
Law enforcement service options for the city, in preparation for public input at town hall meetings on September 19 and September 30
Resolution amending the city's Conflict of Interest Code

los-altos.title: Los Altos City Council — September 22, 2026
los-altos.summary: The Los Altos City Council considered a wastewater treatment plant agreement with Palo Alto and Mountain View, a two-year VTA Board reappointment for Councilmember Weinberg, and a temporary moratorium on new detention or custodial facility applications. The Council also considered appointments to several city commissions and an updated legal services contract with Berliner Cohen, LLP.
keyTopics: Addendum No. 14 to the Regional Water Quality Control Plant Basic Agreement with Palo Alto and Mountain View
Reappointment of Councilmember Jonathan D. Weinberg to the VTA Board for two more years
Interim urgency ordinance establishing a temporary moratorium on detention or custodial and custodial-processing facility applications
Appointments to the Complete Streets, Environmental, and Planning Commissions
Amendment to the legal services agreement with Berliner Cohen, LLP, updating the monthly retainer to $21,500 and hourly rate to $385

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — September 15, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council reviewed routine business, including approval of minutes from prior meetings and a monthly financial and investment report for July 2026. The Council also considered several contract-related items, including amendments to service agreements and new professional services agreements, along with an amendment related to heating, ventilation, and air conditioning work.
keyTopics: Approval of minutes from the September 1, 2026 Closed Session and regular Town Council meetings
Monthly Financial and Investment Report for July 2026
Second amendment to an existing agreement (Town Manager authorization)
First amendment to a Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) services agreement
New professional services agreements authorized for Town Manager execution

san-jose.body: Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole
san-jose.title: San José Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole — September 23, 2026
san-jose.summary: The Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole met to review the upcoming September 29 and October 6, 2026 City Council agendas, including adding items and setting any required time-certain slots. The committee also considered the public record for a recent week, mayoral travel requests, and a District 1 funding item for a local agency formation commission group.
keyTopics: Review and adjustments to the September 29, 2026 final Council agenda
Review and adjustments to the October 6, 2026 draft Council agenda
The public record covering September 10-17, 2026
Requests to travel submitted by the Mayor
District 1 San Jose Sharks Community Funds approval for the California Association of Local Agency Formation Commissions

mountain-view.title: Mountain View City Council — September 22, 2026
mountain-view.summary: The Mountain View City Council met in closed session to discuss potential litigation involving several fire truck manufacturers and to consider the appointment of a City Attorney. In the regular session, the Council took up items including a solar and battery storage energy project, a historic preservation ordinance and zoning map update, an active transportation plan, and salary adjustments for the City Clerk and City Manager.
keyTopics: Potential legal case involving fire apparatus manufacturers (Golden State Fire Apparatus, Pierce, Oshkosh, REV Group, Rosenbauer, FAMA)
Public Employee Appointment for the position of City Attorney
Energy services contract for solar photovoltaic systems and battery energy storage
Historic Preservation Ordinance and zoning map update
Active Transportation Plan adoption and annual compensation increases for the City Clerk and City Manager

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — September 19, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: This was a special morning session of the Sunnyvale City Council held for the annual 'State of the City' event. The agenda was procedural, covering the event schedule and standard logistics for public participation rather than substantive policy decisions.
keyTopics: State of the City special meeting and event schedule
Options for in-person, online, and written public comment

cupertino.title: Cupertino City Council — September 15, 2026
cupertino.summary: The Cupertino City Council met to discuss a potential property negotiation involving 10480 Finch Avenue with the Cupertino Union School District, along with possible litigation matters in closed session. The public portion covered a range of routine business, including an AI use policy for the Council, a response to a county grand jury report on pothole claims, and appointments to a subcommittee for selecting the city's next lobbyist.
keyTopics: Closed session on potential litigation and real property negotiations for 10480 Finch Avenue with Cupertino Union School District
Introduction of an ordinance updating building code definitions for 'attic,' 'garages,' and 'square footage' (postponed to October 6, 2026)
Adoption of an Artificial Intelligence (AI) City Council Policy
Appointment of Mayor Kitty Moore and Councilmember Ray Wang to a subcommittee evaluating city lobbyist proposals for 2027-2028
Approval of the city's response to the county Civil Grand Jury report on pothole damage claims processes

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — September 22, 2026
santa-clara.summary: The Santa Clara City Council held a joint meeting with the Stadium Authority Board that included a closed session on litigation matters and a legal claim, followed by several proclamations and routine purchasing decisions. The Council also considered deferring an ordinance related to state-mandated replacement housing regulations.
keyTopics: Closed session on litigation involving Silicon Valley Power/Northern California Power Agency vs. the California Department of Water Resources, plus anticipated litigation and a property damage claim from Travelers Insurance
Deferral of an ordinance to create new zoning rules (Chapter 18.68) for replacement housing units required under state law
Proclamations recognizing Hispanic Heritage Month, Childhood Cancer Awareness Month, and Public Power Week
Approval process for a HVAC control systems agreement with Syserco, Inc.
Increase to a purchase order with D & D Learning Spaces for office furniture installation and removal at a city building

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — September 15, 2026
milpitas.summary: The Milpitas City Council reviewed a draft plan for how the city will use federal Community Development Block Grant funds, and heard updates on red light camera traffic safety and the condition of the Milpitas Community Center. The Council also took up financial actions related to the former Redevelopment Agency, including a bond refunding resolution.
keyTopics: Draft Program Year 2025 Community Development Block Grant Consolidated Plan
Presentation on the Red Light Camera Traffic Safety Program
Presentation on the condition of the Milpitas Community Center
Resolution of the Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency
Sale and issuance of refunding bonds for the Successor Agency

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto Architectural Review Board — September 17, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Architectural Review Board considered a proposal for 950 Page Mill Road involving a master sign program for a new multi-tenant monument sign. The sign would include non-tenant property branding reading 'Page Mill Labs' along with four separate panels identifying individual tenants of the property.
keyTopics: Major Architectural Review of a master sign program at 950 Page Mill Road
Multi-tenant monument sign design featuring 'Page Mill Labs' property branding
Inclusion of four tenant identification panels on the sign
CEQA exemption finding under Guidelines Section 15311 (Accessory Structures)
